nuggets.text: The Falcons used 17 different ball carriers to rush for 431 yards in a 34-0 opening win over Duquesne.
Liam Szarka ran for two touchdowns in the Falcons' season-opening shutout of Duquesne.
Falcon Stadium sits at 6,621 feet, the second-highest field in FBS, behind only Wyoming's War Memorial Stadium.
Falcon Stadium is built into a natural bowl about 500 feet below the Air Force Academy's cadet area.
Falcon Stadium hosted an NHL game in 2020: the Colorado Avalanche against the Los Angeles Kings.
The Falcons' live mascot is Nova, a female white-phase gyrfalcon who has held the job since 2020.
The falcon mascot was chosen by a vote of the Class of 1959, the Academy's first graduating class.
Troy Calhoun played quarterback for the Falcons and graduated from the Academy in 1989 before becoming its head coach.
Troy Calhoun was the Houston Texans' offensive coordinator in 2006, right before taking over at Air Force.
The Falcons have won the Commander-in-Chief's Trophy 21 times, more than either Army or Navy.
